reason: After reindexing the reversed-weight sum, the difference of the two dot products can be paired symmetrically as Σ_{i=1}^{⌊m/2⌋}(x_i-x_{m+1-i})(w_i-w_{m+1-i}) in the nonincreasing case, and as Σ_{i=1}^{⌊m/2⌋}(x_{m+1-i}-x_i)(w_i-w_{m+1-i}) in the nondecreasing case. Each summand is nonnegative because x is monotone and w is strictly decreasing; if x is nonconstant, the i=1 summand is strictly positive.
